column1: # The volume parser's corpus (phase 4 unit VG): manga title, chapter name as the source sends it,
# and the volume VolumeRecognition must read from it, or - for none. Every title is invented.
# VolumeRecognitionTest reads every row; SyncVolumePushTest names a 3,000-entry library's chapters
# from these rows in turn, so the share of names with a volume there is the share here.
# Volume markers, each form of upstream's volume tokens (v, ver, vol, version, volume).
# A title that carries a marker of its own is removed first, as for the chapter number.
# A revision marker reads as a volume: v, ver and version are upstream's volume tokens.
# No marker: a chapter number alone, a title with digits, words that end in a token.
# A number glued to another token.
# Seasons are not volumes: s and season stay out (the report gives the reasons).
